subtitle: agents shape territory through their decaying memory
summary: Simulation of 512 agents on a shared field. Each agent steers by blending four influences: attraction toward remaining resource, a pull along the trace field left by earlier passages, avoidance of scarred and crowded ground, and a small exploration term. As it moves it consumes resource, which recovers slowly, and deposits a decaying trace of its passage. Ground under repeated traffic scars over: scarred cells deflect later routes, and scars heal only with no traffic. The territory structured by routes written, overused, scarred over, and rerouted.
title: Memory Field
